basalt.description: Bedrock: frames the browser as the tab strip and floors every well. Also the label on the cobalt key (6.1:1, where firn would fail AA) and the glyph inlay on light specimens.

stratum.description: The ground every page stands on, under the drifting survey contours. Every contrast figure in the palette is measured against it.

scree.description: A slab's face: stone keys, plates, the open tab and the address row it runs into. Sunk toward basalt, the dark sediment band.

talus.description: Lightens keycaps, pebbles and hovered rows (mixed into scree) and rims a hovered well. Sunk toward basalt, the light sediment band. The stone specimen and the scrollbar thumb.

ash.description: Muted text: placeholders, resting icons, inactive tabs, key hints. 4.80:1 on stratum, the AA floor; nothing dimmer exists.

snowmelt.description: Supporting text: the annotation tier, ledes, toolbar icons at rest. 8.87:1 on stratum.

firn.description: Primary text, and the light that falls on every lip and lit face. 13.94:1 on stratum; deliberately not pure white.

cobalt.description: Reserved for actions, focus and active state: the one cobalt key per view, a focused well's meltwater rim, a chosen scope, the focus ring. 4.80:1 on stratum. The Apps specimen.

juniper.description: Verdict: allowed, always with its text and glyph. 9.53:1 on stratum. Also the History specimen and the address bar's lock.

calcite.description: Verdict: warned, always with its text and glyph. 12.63:1 on stratum. Also the Bookmarks specimen.

sandstone.description: Verdict: error, always with its text and glyph. 6.58:1 on stratum. Also the Extensions specimen and the rate-limit notice's rim.

wine.description: Verdict: blocked, always with its text and glyph. 4.77:1 on stratum. Also the Restricted domains specimen, destructive menu rows and field errors.

welcome.purpose: The new-tab heading on desktop. Raised lettering: a one-pixel basalt shadow directly under the glyphs and a short soft one below, balanced wrapping, -0.035em.

welcome-mobile.purpose: The same heading at 600px and below.

title.purpose: Interior page titles and the stop card title, beside the page's specimen. Weight 600, line height 1.2, -0.015em, in raised lettering.

body.purpose: Running text: the new-tab description (1.6 line height, snowmelt) and the main search input.

label.purpose: Control labels and rows: the Browse key, search suggestion rows, field inputs, shortcut titles at weight 500.

annotation.purpose: The annotation tier: weight 500, 0.02em tracking, tabular numerals, in snowmelt. Rule, field and ledger labels, metadata, stone-key text. Verdict tokens take the same size in IBM Plex Mono.

caption.purpose: Captions in ash: shortcut descriptions and the new-tab footer.

chrome.purpose: Dense browser labels: tab titles (weight 500, 0.01em; 600 on the open tab), the address field, suggestion and history rows.

control.purpose: Controls and menus: context menu rows, the chrome's base size, the cobalt key's label.

lede.purpose: The paragraph under a page title: 1.55 line height, 60ch measure, snowmelt. The tab switcher's search input shares the size.

display.purpose: The 404 numeral, the one display size (fluid, up to 88px), cut as a block of strata six banded shadows deep.

keycap.purpose: Keycaps drawn as kbd: the tab switcher's keyboard hints.

chip.purpose: Chips and menu rows, in the 7 to 9px small band: bookmark pebbles, detected-filter chips, context menu rows, the new-tab keycap.

button.purpose: Small keys: stone keys and the 32px toolbar keycaps. The band runs down to 7px on 24px keycaps; rows and tabs sit a step up at 10px.

field.purpose: Fields and wells: labelled fields, the tab switcher's search, the Browse key seated in the main search.

menu.purpose: Menus and pickers: context menus, search and address suggestions.

tablet.purpose: Tablets, tiles and toasts: the filter report, new-tab shortcuts, the tab switcher.

search.purpose: The main search well and the stop card.

specimen.purpose: Mineral specimens: the corners scale with the tile.

pill.purpose: A full pill, only for status badges.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Anything that should feel physically seated when it lands: a slab rising, a specimen tilting.

motion.name: ease-enter
motion.purpose: Decelerate-only entrances that should not overshoot; a lifted slab's shadow follows on it without bounce.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Hover and press feedback on a control under the cursor.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: A state change you are meant to notice: a well's rim, a colour change.

motion.name: dur-lift
motion.purpose: A slab rising, long enough for the spring to settle.

motion.name: lift
motion.value: transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)
motion.purpose: How a slab moves: hover rises 2px and deepens the edge by two bands with a far shadow. Only the element under the pointer transitions its shadow.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press sinks the face into its bed with one band left.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Entrance: sections rise 10px and fade in, staggered 50ms in reading order. Backwards fill, so hover transforms still apply once it lands.

motion.name: ground-drift
motion.purpose: The ground's terrain layer at 7% opacity drifts translate3d(-180px, -120px, 0) over four minutes. Transform only.

motion.name: ground-breathe
motion.purpose: Grain under the cobalt dawn at the top edge breathes from 0.55 to full opacity. Opacity only.

motion.name: icon-lift
motion.purpose: An icon's face and rim lift on hover or its control's keyboard focus while the extrusion stays, so the solid deepens.

motion.name: icon-gesture
motion.purpose: Each glyph's own gesture on all three layers: meridians narrow, hands turn, divider lines move, arrows extend.

motion.name: specimen-tilt
motion.value: transform 480ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 480ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-position 900ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
motion.purpose: A specimen tilts toward the reader, its glyph lifts on its own plane and a sheen sweeps the face.

motion.name: specimen-sheen
motion.purpose: The one occasional sheen, on the New Tab emblem: it rests for most of the cycle, then passes.

motion.name: plate-settle
motion.purpose: A menu settles into place from translateY(-6px) scale(0.98).

motion.name: tab-rise
motion.purpose: A new tab rises out of the bedrock from translateY(6px).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: The global rule in global.css.ts collapses durations, so every loop stops and every state still reaches its end.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: At 600px and below, shortcuts form two columns, the new-tab heading drops to 30px, and the Browse label yields to its arrow with an accessible name.

narrative.overview:
Civil is a browser workspace for people who want to reach a website without learning proxy internals. The interface gives search priority, keeps familiar browser controls visible, and offers clearly labeled destinations.

Its material is Strata. The palette is geological, so the interface is cut from layered stone: anything you can press is a slab whose exposed side shows its sediment bands, anything you can type into is a well carved into the stone, large icons are mineral specimens, and every page stands on a ground of faint survey contours that drift very slowly. Height carries the meaning, which is what keeps a textured interface easy to read: flat is text, raised is pressable, carved is typeable. The palette and the wordmark remain the brand anchors.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt is reserved for actions, focus, and active state: the one cobalt key per view, a focused well's meltwater rim, a chosen scope.
Preserve verdict semantics: juniper allowed, calcite warned, sandstone error, wine blocked. Pair every verdict with text and a glyph.
Each destination keeps one mineral everywhere it appears (Apps cobalt, Bookmarks calcite, History juniper, Extensions sandstone, Filter check stone, Restricted domains wine).
Every derived tone (bands, highlights, tinted faces) is a `color-mix()` of palette slots.
Black appears only inside shadows, which are missing light rather than a surface colour.
Every label is sentence case at its natural size: "Add a site", "Filters on this network", "Check this site".
Performance is still a design constraint, because the primary reader is on a low-end school Chromebook.
The only ambient animations are transform and opacity on the ground's two layers and one occasional sheen on the New Tab emblem.

rules.name: Ground (GROUND)
rules.body: stratum; the terrain tile (public/assets/terrain.svg, generated from periodic noise so it repeats without a seam) on one fixed layer at 7% that drifts 180 by 120 pixels over four minutes; grain under a cobalt dawn at the top edge that breathes over eighteen seconds. Both layers are pseudo-elements, so the page gains no DOM.

rules.name: Slab edge (edge(px))
rules.body: `px` one-pixel hard offsets alternating two sediment tones, then a contact shadow. Levels: pebble 1, keycap 2, key 3, tablet 4, plate 6.

rules.name: Face (litFace)
rules.body: grain over a gradient from 10% firn at the top edge down to the surface, plus a firn lip along the top.

rules.name: Pressable (KEY_COBALT, KEY_STONE, KEYCAP, PEBBLE)
rules.body: hover rises 2px and deepens the edge by two bands with a far shadow; press sinks the face into its bed with one band left. A `::before` strip below keeps the pointer inside a risen slab so it cannot flicker; lifted containers use `SKIRT`, which sits behind their children.

rules.name: Tablet (TABLET) and plate (PLATE)
rules.body: content beds and floating slabs (menus, pickers, toasts, the stop card). They do not move.

rules.name: Row (ROW_LIFT)
rules.body: engraved and flat at rest so long lists stay calm; the row under the pointer or holding focus lifts 1px as a small chip.

rules.name: Well (WELL)
rules.body: basalt with grain, a shadowed upper wall, a lit lower rim; hover rims it in talus, focus floods the rim with cobalt meltwater (`WELL_FOCUS`). The row carries focus; the input inside draws no ring.

rules.name: Rules are grooves
rules.body: a shadowed line with a firn lip beneath.

rules.name: Entrance
rules.body: sections rise 10px and fade in, 560ms decelerating, staggered 50ms (`RISE`, backwards fill so hover transforms still apply afterwards).

dos: Keep the palette unchanged and semantic statuses redundant.
Preserve visible keyboard focus, accessible control names, and reduced-motion support. The global rule in global.css.ts collapses durations, so every loop stops and every state still reaches its end.
Keep technical implementation labels out of the beginner's start screen.
Spread material recipes with `blend()`; do not compose them as classes.
Give anything pressable a hover, a press and a focus state; leave static text still.
In Solid 2 onSettled callbacks, return cleanup functions; never call onCleanup inside them.
Keep interactive controls reachable by keyboard and touch when hover is unavailable.
donts: Do not add `backdrop-filter`, large blurs, animated filters, or a second ambient animation per page.
Do not add animation dependencies for CSS path transforms.
Do not export bare functions from .css.ts files that components import; vanilla-extract requires serializable exports. material.css.ts is imported only by other .css.ts files, which is why it may.
